text:
Maria: Heads-up: need cross-team alignment for Falcon launch acceptance criteria. Goal: decide minimal runtime/infra/security scope for initial pilot next sprint. @Kevin @Sam @Jess can you confirm capacity and gating?
Kevin: Quick read: runtime is ok for single-model pilot but KV cache needs feature flag. We can support ~200 concurrent sessions if batching enabled.
Sam: Infra side: we have 4 reserved GPUs for Dedicated pilot. Need migration window for autoscaler config. Also need IP allowlist for Private tests.
Jess: Security: HSM/KMS access will take ~2 weeks to approve for pilot. If can't wait, we can use ephemeral keys + audit logging as fallback.
Ada: Customer asked for per-tenant SLA and privacy opt-out. For pilot we should limit to opt-in tenants only.
Claire: Platform: deploy pipeline has a canary stage but no automated rollback on perf regressions. We should add a perf probe: `curl /health?probe=latency` threshold 150ms.
Kevin: Agree on probe. Also propose throttling policy: `max_tokens_per_minute=50000` per tenant during pilot.
Maria: Can we list launch gates? I'll paste a short checklist.
Maria: ```
- runtime: KV cache flag on
- infra: autoscaler + 4 GPUs provisioned
- security: audit logs enabled OR KMS approved
- prod-sim: run load test 10k qps for 30m
- product: 2 customer opt-in tenants
```
Sam: Autoscaler change requires DB schema migration to store slot-leases. ETA 3 days.
Jess: If KMS not approved, we'll enable `ephemeral_kms=true` and strict audit retention (90d).
Kevin: Runtime change ready; just need infra deploy window (Sam + Claire) and QA signoff.
Claire: I can reserve 2-hour window Wed AM. Ops-bot schedules?
deploy-bot: Schedule suggestion: Wed 09:00-11:00 UTC. Confirm with `+1` reaction.
Ada: I'll own customer comms and the acceptance test plan. +1 on Wed.
Maria: Ok. Action items: Kevin implement KV flag PR by EOD Mon; Sam do autoscaler migration Tue; Jess start KMS approval; Claire lock Wed slot; Ada prepare test plan. Reactions? :thumbsup:
Kevin: On it. PR created: `github.com/redwood/falcon#234`
Sam: I noted DB migration in infra board: https://linear.app/infra/issue/INF-88
Jess: Started KMS request ticket: SEC-412. Added list of required docs.
Maria: Thanks all. We'll reconvene Tue 16:00 to confirm readiness. If any blockers ping me.
